evals.name: restating-comments-service
evals.expected_output: All 6 added comments in src/users/users.service.ts that restate code (incl. trailing comment and signature-only TSDoc on a private method) are removed; code and the 2 pre-existing comments are unchanged.
assertions: Every planted restating comment is removed
Non-comment code is identical to the input
Pre-existing comments from HEAD are untouched
Report includes git diff --stat and a per-file removed/shortened count

evals.name: changelog-and-commented-out-code-controller
evals.expected_output: Changelog comments ('Updated: ... as requested', 'fixed: ...', 'Added ...', 'previously ...') and commented-out code in src/auth/auth.controller.ts are removed; code (including the trailing-comment line) is unchanged.
assertions: Every commented-out code line is removed
Non-comment code is identical to the input
Report includes git diff --stat and a per-file removed/shortened count

evals.name: keep-why-comment-and-eslint-directive
evals.expected_output: The 2-line 'why' comment (case-sensitive index, D-16) and the eslint-disable-next-line directive are both kept; the file is left unchanged and the report lists both under Kept with a reason.
assertions: Non-comment code is identical to the input
Report lists kept comments with a reason
